Replicated Rebrew projects (read_backends and write_backends sqlite, toml), one directory per rebrew release
that wrote it: the recorded sample's project and function metadata (tests/test_ops_retained.py recorded_sample)
with the [metadata] lists added, then `rebrew.metadata_transfer.reconcile_metadata` run under that release's
wheel. The SQLite database is left out, as in a fresh clone; reads then use the TOML replica, the journal and
the replication state.

  rebrew-6.45.1  format = 1, records without content_sha256
  rebrew-6.59.0  format = 1, records with content_sha256
  rebrew-6.60.0  format = 2, content_sha256 required

tests/test_cli.py (TestReplicatedMetadata) reads each in live mode, and holds the format and record fields the
pinned rebrew writes equal to those of the pinned release's directory. When a rebrew pin moves the format, add
a directory written by that release the same way; do not edit these files by hand.
